title: Document Code Upgrades for Insurance Supplements
summary: Turn jobsite photos and notes into a clean daily record and draft supplement letters for code-upgrade work, so insurance jobs are not short-paid for work you had to do.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you work insurance jobs with required code upgrades; the value is getting paid for that work, though the carrier decides.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Fewer insurance jobs short-paid for required code work.
Fewer missed calls while you are on a job.

outputs: A clean photo record per job

steps: Capture photos and voice notes on every insurance job.
Collect them into a daily packet.
Draft a supplement letter for the code-upgrade items.
Check each code citation and send it yourself.
guardrails: Verify every code citation with your local authority.
Not legal or public adjusting advice; follow your state rules.
